about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Vogue ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Vogue was a flagship trim of the Range Rover, spanning the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021) generations. Across these generations, the Vogue was available with a choice of two diesel engine families: the 3.0-litre six-cylinder (TDV6/SDV6) and the 4.4-litre V8 (TDV8/SDV8). The Vogue trim was discontinued with the introduction of the L460 generation in 2022, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8 engines for every Range Rover Vogue on the road.

codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Vogue ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Vogue across both the L322 and L405 generations. Known for timing chain and injector wear over time — see the callout above. We replace these as standard on every TDV6 rebuild, along with EGR, turbo and gasket components.
cards.cta: Check Your TDV6 Range Rover Vogue

cards.body: A higher-output 3.0-litre V6 diesel, also fitted across L322 and L405 generations. Shares the same timing chain and injector wear pattern as the TDV6. We service it to the same standard.
cards.cta: Check Your SDV6 Range Rover Vogue

cards.body: A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Vogue across both generations. Known for the same timing chain and injector wear pattern as its six-cylinder siblings — this is a consistent trait across the engine family.

cards.body: A higher-output 4.4-litre V8 diesel, also fitted across L322 and L405 generations. Shares the same engine family traits as the TDV8.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Vogue ENGINE
compatibility.intro: Because the Range Rover Vogue was available with multiple diesel engines across two generations, matching the correct engine to your car is critical. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (TDV6, SDV6, TDV8 or SDV8) via registration or VIN - Your generation (L322 or L405) - Ancillary and ECU specification specific to your exact build

points.text: Your exact engine code (TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
